posts.title: The World Will Use Less Natural Gas in 2026
posts.description: 2026 will see a historic downturn in global natural gas demand. However, it can be hard to pick up this trend if you are just reading the financial press. For example, take this recent Reuters headline. Pretty clear, right? Global demand is soaring in 2026 according to the headline.
